item.title: Emancipation Month Program: African Drumming with Dr. Isaac Nii Akrong — Thu Aug 20, 2:00 PM — Maria A. Shchuka
item.description:
August is recognized as Emancipation Month in Ontario, a time to commemorate the abolition of slavery and celebrate the contributions of Black Communities. In this workshop with Dr. Isaac Nii Akrong ( www.isaacniiakrong.com ), participants will learn West African drumming forms such as kpanlogo , djembe and sogo . Along with learning proper techniques and playing with songs, everyone will learn about the history of the drums, how they are made, and the cultural significance of the music. The rhythmic patterns bring natural joy! No previous experience required – all ages and abilities welcome. Drop-in. No registration required.
Source: Toronto Public Library — School Age
